<subanswer>
1. Identify legumes with flowers and edible seeds:
   - Peanut (A. hypogaea)
   - Chickpea, Garbanzo Bean, Gram (C. arietinum)
   - Pea (P. sativum)
   - Indian Beechnut (M. pinnata)
   - Pigeon Pea (C. Cajan)
   - Soybean (G. max)
   - Lima Bean (P. lunatus)
   - Common Bean (P. vulgaris)
   - Adzuki Bean (V. angularis)
   - Black Gram (V. mungo)
   - Mung Bean, Green Gram (V. radiata)
   - Bambara Groundnut (V. subterranea)
   - Cowpea (V. unguiculata)
   - Lentil (L. culinaris)
   - Fava Bean, Broad Bean (V. faba)

2. Among these, all listed species have flowers and are known for their edible seeds.
